message: すきま
In the morning, I went to school earlier than usual again today so I wouldn't run into him.
My heart feels heavy, but there's no need to dwell on it.
I've merely returned to the days before I became Vice President. I'm sure I'll get used to commuting alone soon enough.

name: Nanaka
message: 「Morning, Misa! Hah, hah, hah, haa!」
The instant I started heading from the entrance toward the classroom, a voice called out to me with an energetic greeting.

name: Misa
message: 「Good morning, Nanaka-san.」

name: Misa
message: 「A-Are you alright? You're completely out of breath...」

name: Nanaka
message: 「I'm fine, I'm fine! That whole slight fever fuss yesterday was just Synn overreacting. I ran here this morning for the first time in a while.」
Over Nanaka-san's shoulder, he is standing in a corner of the shoe locker area.
He must have run here too. His shoulders are heaving as he catches his breath, while Paqy-san rubs his back.
Or perhaps Nanaka-san gave him an affectionate slap on the back.

name: Nanaka
message: 「This morning, Synn spotted you way ahead on the road to school. So we did a 'ready, set, go!' race and chased after you.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「We didn't end up catching you, but it kinda feels great. Ahahaha!」

name: Misa
message: 「Yes, I understand that exhilarating feeling quite well.」
Nanaka-san's smile is dazzling to me.
I avert my eyes just a little.

name: Misa
message: 「Hmph!」
Carelessly, my eyes ended up meeting his.
Without a trace of a Student Council President's dignity, he gives a slight nod with a beaming smile and waves at me.
As if I would ever wave back.

name: Nanaka
message: 「Misa? Why are you waving your arms around like you're doing calisthenics?」

name: Misa
message: 「Nngh...! I-It's a hand exercise.」
This behavior has nothing to do with my own willpower.
My sense of propriety as Vice President must have triggered a conditioned reflex. Or rather, I wasn't greeting him, I was greeting Paqy-san.
That just means I need further self-discipline. Brace yourself, me! Bring it on, me!!

name: Misa
message: 「Grr!」
I glare at him.
His response to me is a wry smile.
For whatever reason, he makes no move to leave the spot.
Since it's a conversation between girls, he's probably being considerate in his own way. I doubt he's noticed our united front.

name: Nanaka
message: 「Sorry about yesterday!」

name: Misa
message: 「Huh...? Oh! Y-Yeah, that's right, you need to pull yourself together!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Sorry about that. I always end up making you look after me, Misa.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「B-But got it. Leave it to me.」

name: Misa
message: 「I'll bolster our support system too. I'll subtly pull some strings in all the right places.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「R-Really!?」

name: Misa
message: 「Hmph, who do you take me for? I'm the vice president, fiercely eyeing the president's seat, you know? Scheming and maneuvering are my forte.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「To be honest, I don't really get the complicated stuff, but that's a huge help. Let me treat you to some sweets next time!」

name: Misa
message: 「If things go well, I'll gladly take you up on that.」

name: Misa
message: 「However, I'm strictly playing a supporting role. You have to take the initiative yourself, Nanaka-san.」

name: Misa
message: 「For example, going to Sakura―kun's room to borrow his notes, and then alone together―」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Oh, that? This morning, while Synn was eating soba, I copied them down super fast.」

name: Misa
message: 「W-What have you done? That was such a golden opportunity.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Haha, tahahaha...」

name: Misa
message: 「Hehe. You're so honest and straightforward, Nanaka-san... It's pure love, isn't it? I'm jealous.」
I unexpectedly become conscious of the words I had just muttered so casually.
The reason Nanaka-san's smile looked so dazzling.
Unlike me, she doesn't make pointless calculations. She faces her feelings of "liking" someone head-on.
That's what makes me envious.

name: Nanaka
message: 「This morning, I was chatting with Synn like usual, and I even made delicious soba that got Paqy's stamp of approval.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「...And yet, the moment I start thinking about how I like Synn, I start acting all weird...」

name: Nanaka
message: 「It feels like a Synn-shaped gap just popped right open dead center in my body...」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Tahahaha, that makes no sense at all when I put it like that.」

name: Misa
message: 「Hmm, I sort of get what you mean.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Oh, right, also! Misa, you're going a bit overboard, you know. I want you to set us up alone together in a more natural way.」

name: Misa
message: 「W-What a demanding request.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Tehehe, I'm counting on you!」

name: Misa
message: 「Let's see... Today, the Student Council is scheduled to split into three groups and act separately, right?」

name: Misa
message: 「Sakura-kun and I are paired up, but I'm going to fake an illness called acute peritoneal ptosis distension and hide in the infirmary, so won't you team up with him in my place, Nanaka-san?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Gaaah, what's natural about a serious illness like that!」

name: Misa
message: 「It's not that big of a disease, you know? Put simply, it just means 'overeating.'」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Anyway, I'm good for today. I won't rush it--I'll try telling him my feelings slowly.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Synn and I have been together since we were kids, after all. We'll take things slow at our own pace!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Well then! See you in the Student Council room at lunch!」
Having completely caught her breath by now, Nanaka-san runs off toward him.
And then, she slaps him repeatedly on the back.
Even though he went out of his way to wait until we finished talking, he probably just cracked some stupid joke.

name: Synn
message: 「Nanaka's been acting weird since yesterday...」

name: Misa
message: 「Oh! So even you can notice a change in Nanaka-san, Sakura-kun.」

name: Synn
message: 「Why do you look so happy?」

name: Misa
message: 「I-I-I-I-I do not! Hmph!!」

name: Paqy
message: 「She's forcing herself to swallow a bitter pill, that hysterical chick.」
After-school Student Council activities.
Misa and I came to the library to do some research. We've already gathered all the books we need. All that's left is to photocopy the reference pages.

name: Synn
message: 「We're past the hardest part of our split tasks.」

name: Misa
message: 「Yes, only our routine work remains now.」

name: Synn
message: 「...Hey, Misa, this has nothing to do with Student Council activities, but do you know anything about what's going on with Nanaka?」

name: Synn
message: 「You're the only one I can talk to about something like this.」

name: Misa
message: 「...Hearing you say that doesn't feel bad at all. Very well, ask me anything.」

name: Misa
message: 「Come on, come on, hurry up.」

name: Synn
message: 「That's unexpected. I was sure you'd get mad at me for bringing up personal matters as the Student Council President.」

name: Misa
message: 「A-Ahem! This too is my duty as Vice President. Nanaka-san is a precious comrade, after all.」

name: Synn
message: 「True, if Nanaka stays like that, it might interfere with preparations for the Holy Night Festival」

name: Synn
message: 「Hey, Misa, I know you saw how Nanaka was yesterday, but even after that--」
This morning, the Nanaka who came to wake me up was the usual Nanaka.
Making soba noodles and trading playful banter with Paqy. An ordinary breakfast scene, no different from usual.
However, once we actually left the house and started walking to school, Nanaka fell completely silent beside me.
She kept her head down the whole time, her pace unsteady.
After a while, I spotted Misa's back far ahead of us on the road to school.
The moment I mentioned it, Nanaka snapped right back to her usual self, practically dragging me along as she ran to catch up with Misa.

name: Misa
message: 「When we met at the shoe lockers, right? Nanaka-san seemed so lively and full of energy.」

name: Synn
message: 「Only until the chime rang.」
While sitting at my desk in the classroom, I felt like someone was watching me. The person staring was Nanaka, and the moment our eyes met, she hurriedly looked down.
That repeated over and over during class.

Thinking it was some kind of game, I slipped her a note via Sacchin behind the teacher's back, but no reply ever came. Even when I tried talking to her during break, I couldn't get a straight answer out of her.
Yet when lunch break came around, she perked right back up just like when she spotted Misa in the morning, throwing herself into her treasurer duties in the Student Council room.

name: Synn
message: 「And right now, Nanaka's with Lolotte, bright, cheerful, and fired up.」

name: Misa
message: 「Isn't that a good thing?」

name: Synn
message: 「Yeah, except whenever she's alone with me, or when none of our close friends are around, she goes completely quiet.」

name: Synn
message: 「Huh...? Speaking of friends, come to think of it, Nanaka didn't really talk much with Sacchin today either?」

name: Synn
message: 「Though there's no way she had a fight with Sacchin. They were both smiling and whispering to each other, after all.」

name: Misa
message: 「Y-You watched her that closely and still don't get it?」

name: Synn
message: 「If anything, I'm the one being watched, you know?」

name: Misa
message: 「*Sigh*... Don't just look at Nanaka-san on the surface--look at what's inside her heart.」

name: Misa
message: 「Surely you have some idea why, Sakura-kun? Put your hand on your chest and think about it.」

name: Synn
message: 「Wha--on S-Misa's!?」

name: Paqy
message: 「I'll take Ria-chan's tits over a hysterical bitch's any day!」

name: Misa
message: 「I'm telling you to put your hand on your *own* chest!」

name: Synn
message: 「Hmm, something I did to make Nanaka mad...」

name: Synn
message: 「Do you think she's still holding a grudge over that time five years ago when I made a play on pudding a la mode and whipped up pudding a la tofu?」

name: Paqy
message: 「I'm a hundred percent sure that's not it, man.」

name: Misa
message: 「W-What on earth is that mysterious food?」

name: Synn
message: 「My own original healthy menu item. I'll treat you to some next time too, Misa.」

name: Misa
message: 「No thank you!!」

name: Misa
message: 「Honestly! Why is 'making her mad' the very first thing that comes to your mind?! Surely there are more moments that truly capture Nanaka-san's essence!」

name: Misa
message: 「I think it's wonderful how she can pour such pure, passionate feelings into sweets.」

name: Misa
message: 「Starting up a club all on her own and leading its members--that drive, charisma, and organizational skill!」

name: Synn
message: 「Yeah... true. It was practically on the verge of folding before Nanaka rebuilt it, wasn't it...」

name: Synn
message: 「Though, that group doesn't have matches or contests, so it kinda just looks like a club for hanging out with friends?」

name: Misa
message: 「G-Going around tasting sweets at all sorts of shops, never slacking in refining her palate, and voicing her honest opinions no matter who she's dealing with... I could never imitate that.」

name: Synn
message: 「You wouldn't try to imitate her anyway, Misa.」

name: Misa
message: 「Indeed.」

name: Misa
message: 「...Gasp?! N-Never mind about me! Let's talk about Nanaka-san's wonderful qualities.」

name: Synn
message: 「Nanaka's enthusiasm for sweets is amazing and all, but she tends to be pretty reckless.」

name: Synn
message: 「If she realizes those weak points, I'm sure more people will want to join the Sweets Club.」

name: Synn
message: 「They don't splurge, they manage their allowances, and everyone has fun together... The club's doors are wide open, after all.」

name: Misa
message: 「Sakura-kun... you don't just praise her, you genuinely look out for Nanaka-san, don't you?」

name: Synn
message: 「Hmm. If I had to point out one catch, it's probably that Nanaka doesn't actually make sweets herself.」

name: Misa
message: 「N-Nanaka-san makes soba noodles! Even in Ryuusei Town, Yuugiri-an's food is renowned for being exquisite, isn't it?」

name: Misa
message: 「Precisely because she cooks herself, she can put herself in the shoes of the pastry chefs behind the sweets.」

name: Misa
message: 「Nanaka-san's sweet reviews may be harsh, but she never hurts or belittles the people who made them.」

name: Synn
message: 「Yeah, Nanaka always thinks about every little detail for others. Even the soba she makes for me every morning--she subtly adjusts how firm she boils it depending on how I'm feeling」

name: Synn
message: 「Though Nanaka herself never mentions it」

name: Misa
message: 「Right, whether you call it conscientious or overly reserved... that's Nanaka-san's strong point」

name: Misa
message: 「Ah...! Nngh」

name: Misa
message: 「I wanted to tell him about Nanaka-san's good qualities, yet I'm the one getting schooled instead...」

name: Misa
message: 「W-What's the big deal, Sakura-kun? You already know way more good things about Nanaka-san than I do」

name: Synn
message: 「Well, I've known Nanaka longer than anyone except my parents, after all」

name: Synn
message: 「No, wait a second? It's been pretty long since I started living on my own... The time I've spent with her might actually be longer than with anyone else」

name: Synn
message: 「Nanaka and I are kind of like you and Shio-chan, Misa」

name: Misa
message: 「Is that so? Shio and I are sisters, practically family. That's a bit different from the relationship between you and Nanaka-san, Sakura-kun」

name: Misa
message: 「They really are childhood friends... There was never any room for me to step in from the start...」

name: Misa
message: 「O-Oh...? Why am I...?」

name: Synn
message: 「Thanks. Having someone listen made me feel a bit better」

name: Misa
message: 「Y-You're welcome」

name: Synn
message: 「Alright, let's get back to work」

name: Synn
message: 「Hmm, we pulled out too much reference material. Let's sort through it on that side table over there」

name: Synn
message: 「We need to separate what needs copying from what doesn't. And for the books that look useful from cover to cover, let's check them out together, Misa」

name: Misa
message: 「Sakura-kun...」

name: Synn
message: 「What's wrong, Misa? Did you have a suggestion?」

name: Misa
message: 「Huh!? U-U-U-Um, er, well...」

name: Misa
message: 「H-Hmph, it's nothing! You can handle something like sorting reference materials on your own!」

name: Synn
message: 「Yeah, except you're holding half of them in your hands, Misa」

name: Misa
message: 「T―This is―」

name: Synn
message: 「S-Sorry. I'll pick them up」

name: Misa
message: 「No, I'll pick them up myself!」
Misa and I reach out at almost the exact same time for the documents that fell to the floor.
Our hands brush against each other.
Even though I moved first, Misa was half a beat faster to grab them. My hand ends up resting over hers, wrapping around her small fingers.

name: Misa
message: 「S-Sakura-kun...」
Our faces are so close. I can even feel her breath.

name: Misa
message: 「W-Why are you going quiet on me...」

name: Synn
message: 「Y-Yeah...」

name: Synn
message: 「Misa, for a long time now, I've...」
My heart pounds loudly. My palms feel hot. Before my mind can even think, I naturally try to confess my feelings to Misa.
Hearing her gasp as if frightened, I swallow my words. Misa's hand grows colder and colder.

name: Misa
message: 「A-A gap...? In me too... So that's why...」

name: Misa
message: 「I see...」

name: Misa
message: 「I-Idiot... The biggest idiot in the world. If I had just thought about it for a second, I would've realized...」

name: Synn
message: 「...Misa?」

name: Misa
message: 「But, it's already...」

name: Misa
message: 「...Sakura-kun, let go of my hand」

name: Synn
message: 「No」

name: Misa
message: 「W-W-W-Wha--!? What are you saying! I don't recall ever giving you permission to hold my hand!」

name: Synn
message: 「Yeah, I didn't get your approval」

name: Misa
message: 「Then let go!!」

name: Synn
message: 「No」

name: Misa
message: 「W-Why...」

name: Synn
message: 「Because your hand is cold, Misa. Usually it's much warmer...」

name: Misa
message: 「Y-You've barely held my hand more than a handful of times, so don't talk like you know everything!」
Misa puts her whole body weight into pulling her hand back, trying to shake off my restraint.
...I don't let go of Misa's hand.
Misa's momentum doesn't stop, and as a result, the two of us end up crashing straight into a bookshelf.

name: Misa
message: 「Owww~~!」

name: Synn
message: 「Misa, are you okay? You've got a bump forming. I'll rub it, so just bear with it for a bit, okay?」

name: Misa
message: 「If you were going to let go of my hand now, you should've just let go quietly earlier!!」

name: Synn
message: 「Uhh, so you're okay with me rubbing it?」

name: Misa
message: 「I am not!!」

name: Synn
message: 「Whoa, the bookshelf...」
The massive bookshelves neatly lined up in the library begin toppling over one after another like dominoes, starting from where we're standing.

name: Synn
message: 「This has turned into a huge mess. It's a giant bookshelf domino effect...」

name: Misa
message: 「Books are scattered all over the floor. This disaster is our fault, isn't it...」
Well now, we have to do something about this.

name: Melilot
message: 「Just what do you think you are doing?」

name: Misa
message: 「Eek!?」

name: Synn
message: 「M-Melilot-san」

name: Melilot
message: 「Please be quiet in the library. Your lovers' quarrel was echoing throughout the entire building.」

name: Synn
message: 「A l-lovers' quarrel...」

name: Melilot
message: 「'Lovers' talk' refers to playful banter exchanged between two people in love.」

name: Misa
message: 「Wh―what―!?」

name: Melilot
message: 「Now then, I'll leave the two of you to clean this up together, nicely.」

name: Synn
message: 「Shall we get started, Misa?」

name: Misa
message: 「I-I know that...\s03」
Under Melilot-san's watchful eye, Misa and I begin cleaning up. It doesn't look like we'll be making it back to the Student Council room today.
